description: This file defines the ListNotificationOptionsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and editing of notification list options within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for building display and edit views, updating models, and setting view model properties.

classes.name: ListNotificationOptionsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing the presentation and editing of ListNotificationOptions in OrchardCore.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix for options to 'Options' for binding compatibility.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display view for notification list options, including bulk actions and filters.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the model for editing by mapping filter results and initializing various view components.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Maps form post values to the filter result and proceeds to the edit view.

methods.name: BuildOptionsViewModel
methods.description: Copies properties from the main model to a view model for display or editing.
